title.rendered: So This Happened (EP 402) reviews: Banks earn ₦209bn from maintenance charges

content.rendered:
Nigerian banks reportedly generated a combined ₦209 billion from account maintenance charges in the first quarter of 2026, sparking fresh conversations about banking fees and customer costs.

The revelation came as the Central Bank of Nigeria introduced reforms scrapping maintenance fees on naira debit and credit cards, with many Nigerians questioning how much they pay in charges and whether greater transparency is needed in the banking sector.
